macros.name: bmstyle
macros.doc: Sets the appearance of a certain bookmark level. level can be a positive number (starting with zero) or the character * (= bookmarks originating from starred sections/chapters). style is a set of valid layout options, as seen in section 1.2.3 of the bookmark package documentation [6].

macros.name: embeddedcolor
macros.doc: The annotation text color can be defined with the command \embeddedcolor.

macros.name: goto
macros.doc: This command is used to create links inside or between PDF documents.

macros.name: gotoparent
macros.doc: This is a shortcut of the \goto command. It lets the given text point to a destination in the parent document.

macros.name: listofattachments
macros.doc: Creates a list of file attachments, analogous to the \listoffigures or \listoftables commands.

macros.name: odest
macros.doc: Creates the named destination /name located with a vertical offset relative to the current point.

macros.name: openaction
macros.doc: Sets the PDF document’s open-action. action is the content of an action dictionary.

macros.name: pagelabel
macros.doc: Sets the PDF pagelabel for the specified page.

macros.name: runattachment
macros.doc: Creates a link from any text which launches the embedded file with the given ID.
